query:
SELECT DISTINCT w.id, w.name
               FROM automation.workflow w
               JOIN automation.workflow_version wv ON wv.workflow_id = w.id
               WHERE w.org_id = $1
                 AND wv.graph @> jsonb_build_object(
                       'connectors',
                       jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('credential_id', $2::text))
                     )
               ORDER BY w.name
